title: Kushikatsu Cabbage Bites
description: A Japanese-inspired twist on traditional cabbage bites, coated in a crispy kushikatsu batter and served with a side of charred dipping sauce.
instructions: Cut the cabbage into small florets.
In a shallow dish, mix together the panko breadcrumbs and kushikatsu.
Dip each cabbage floret into the breadcrumb mixture, pressing gently to adhere.
Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Fry the coated cabbage bites until golden brown and crispy, about 3-4 minutes per side.
Transfer the kushikatsu to a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
In a small saucepan, combine the soy sauce, sake, and charred notes.
Bring the mixture to a simmer over medium heat and cook until slightly thickened, about 5 minutes.
Serve the kushikatsu cabbage bites with the charred dipping sauce on the side.
